scope: Run the frozen five learned arms, two controls and fixed/dynamic exit assessment on verified EF snapshots
fit_order: Each learner family and scenario uses the same five frozen folds; comparison consumes all four audited family artifacts
account_clock: Freeze each OPEN's buy gates and integer-share notional budgets one minute before it using the preceding five-minute grid OPEN for held marks. Its three-minute observation delay puts it before the decision. Do not reuse same-OPEN sales or unspent order reservations; block a new buy when already held at the decision. Current OPEN prices settle previously determined actions only.
source_scope: Fixed handoffs from completed EF units only, bound to their original publication, independent receipt audit and sealed artifact hashes. Invented and actual lineages remain separate.
execution: One actual1 per closed unit, after exact source review, CI, normal merge, whole invented run and original receipt audit. No retry or automatic fallback.
